title: Audit Log Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the audit log policy for a feature or service. Enforces: required event fields in schema, no raw PII in log payloads, all high-risk actions have explicit log rules, and retention period is defined.

error_codes.AL001: audit-log-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: schema, actions[], retentionDays
error_codes.AL002: Audit log schema missing required fields — must include: eventId, timestamp, actorId, action, resource, outcome
error_codes.AL003: Raw PII found in log field mapping — mask or hash PII fields before logging
error_codes.AL004: One or more high-risk actions (DELETE, admin ops, auth events) have no audit log rule
error_codes.AL005: Retention period not defined — specify retentionDays or reference a retention policy
